notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market year 2026/27, a forecast (trader reference). Years differ.

The tables of the seed are USDA PSD (marketing years); its flows and seaborne figure are customs data for sunflower seed (HS 120600), gross weight (CEPII BACI); oil seed, seed for sowing and snack seed are not told apart in the code.

The oil and the meal are two more customs groups, each its own code, gross weight, in none of the totals of another: sunflower-seed or safflower oil (HS 151211, 151219), and sunflower-seed oil-cake and other solid residues (HS 230630). Safflower oil is in the oil code with sunflower oil and customs data do not separate them; the USDA oil table is sunflower oil only.
Sunflower and safflower oil (HS 151211, 151219), 2024 (CEPII BACI): world 17.70 Mt gross weight; top exporters Ukraine 5.89 Mt, Russia 4.59 Mt, Turkey 1.04 Mt.
Sunflower meal (HS 230630), 2024 (CEPII BACI): world 11.50 Mt gross weight; top exporters Ukraine 4.45 Mt, Russia 2.06 Mt, Argentina 1.02 Mt.

Production and domestic use of the oil and the meal are USDA PSD tables of marketing years (the Oil and Meal commodities of the file), shown under the seed's; the world balance (area, stocks) is the seed's. Customs tonnage of the oil and the meal is a calendar year, so the two sources differ in year and basis.
The price series is the oil's, not the seed's or the meal's: the Pink Sheet gives sunflower oil only; there is no free series for the seed or the meal.
discrepancies: World exports: USDA PSD 2025/26 4.3 Mt (sum of reporting countries, EU excl. intra-trade) vs BACI 2024 5.3 Mt (-19%); different year and basis (marketing year vs calendar year; BACI includes intra-EU trade, PSD does not); the tables show USDA PSD.
